theme: Myeloid innate inflammation via TLR and complement receptors
core_role: The shared pathways describe how monocytes and myeloid cells pick up danger signals (oxidised LDL, heme, endogenous TLR ligands) and turn them into an inflammatory response. The additional pathways carry this into complement-receptor signalling and neutrophil degranulation as effector outputs.

theme: Amyloid-beta production, fibrillisation and clearance
core_role: The shared pathways are about amyloid proteostasis: amyloid fibril formation, APP processing and amyloid-beta clearance. The additional pathways place this in the early and recycling endosomes, where APP is processed and amyloid-beta is cleared.

theme: tRNA charging and modification for translational fidelity
core_role: The shared pathways cover cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA aminoacylation and wobble-position modification. Here they act as the machinery for accurate codon decoding, alongside t6A modification and maintenance of translational fidelity.

theme: One-carbon metabolism: methionine cycle, folate and cobalamin
core_role: The shared pathways are the methionine/SAM cycle and methionine salvage, including its inborn errors (MAT1A, AHCY, MTR, MTRR). Here they are the methyl-donor hub whose remethylation step depends on folate and cobalamin, the uptake, transport and disorders of which make up the additional pathways.

theme: Misfolded protein triage via aggresomes and selective autophagy
core_role: The shared pathways cover recognising, unfolding and deubiquitinating misfolded proteins (Josephin/ataxin-3) and moving them to the perinuclear region. This is the upstream triage step that feeds aggresome assembly and disposal by aggrephagy, microautophagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy.

theme: Bidirectional control of protein stability by proteasomal degradation
core_role: The shared pathways promote ubiquitin-proteasome turnover and balance protein stabilisation against destabilisation (including RHOBTB2, a CUL3 ligase adaptor). The additional negative regulators act as the opposing brake, so together they tune protein half-life.

theme: RIG-I/MDA5 RNA sensing and type I interferon induction
core_role: The shared pathways are the cytosolic RNA-sensor cascade (RIG-I/MDA5, TRAF3/TRAF6, TBK1/IKKepsilon, IRF3/IRF7, NF-kB) plus its negative regulators and its evasion by viruses. This forms the interferon-inducing arm, whose stimulated-gene output includes ISG15 conjugation.

theme: mRNA 3'-end processing and nuclear export
core_role: The shared pathways cover 3'-end maturation of replication-dependent histone mRNAs (SLBP stem-loop binding and cleavage) and Pol II termination. This is the processing step that makes transcripts competent for export through the nuclear pore.

theme: Antigen processing and presentation by MHC class II and CD1
core_role: The shared pathways cover loading and presenting peptide antigens on MHC class II, and lipid antigens on CD1/MHC Ib, by professional antigen-presenting cells. They are read here in the context of dendritic-cell/monocyte receptor programmes and TLR7 sensing.

theme: Glutamate-aspartate nitrogen metabolism and ammonia handling
core_role: The shared pathways cover glutamate, glutamine and aspartate interconversion as the main nitrogen carriers. Here they feed ammonium homeostasis, NADH transfer by the malate-aspartate shuttle, and creatine synthesis.

theme: Type I interferon-stimulated antiviral response
core_role: The shared pathways are cell-level antiviral responses to IFN-alpha and to cytosolic DNA (OAS, CXCL10/IP-10). They form the core of an interferon-stimulated gene signature that also includes ISG15 and IRF2 targets.

theme: Cytokine signalling shaping NK/NKT and inflammatory responses
core_role: The shared pathways cover common gamma-chain cytokines (IL-15, IL-21) driving NK cell proliferation and differentiation. Here they sit inside a wider JAK-STAT network of IL-12-family, IL-10-family and type I/III interferon signalling that tunes lymphocyte activation and inflammation.

theme: NAD+ metabolism from tryptophan and nicotinate
core_role: The shared pathways cover NAD+ salvage from nicotinate/pyridine nucleotides and NAD+ breakdown. They are the salvage counterpart to de novo NAD+ synthesis through kynurenine, tied to redox state and methylglyoxal/glycation defence.

theme: Monocyte inflammatory activation and TLR regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are the inflammatory effector state of monocytes and myeloid cells. The additional pathways show this state as driven by TLR/MyD88 and CD40 signalling, with negative feedback and changes in antigen presentation.

theme: Insulin and adiponectin control of glucose and fuel storage
core_role: The shared pathways cover adiponectin signalling and control of insulin-stimulated glucose uptake, i.e. insulin sensitivity. This node sits within insulin and glucagon/PKA hormonal control of glycogen and triglyceride metabolism.

theme: Vitamin B1/B2 and related nutrient transport and metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways cover uptake of thiamine and riboflavin and their conversion into coenzymes (TPP, FMN/FAD). Here they are part of micronutrient and cofactor supply, together with carnitine and choline handling and flavin-dependent FMO oxidation.

theme: Stress-induced senescence versus p53 apoptosis after DNA damage
core_role: The shared pathways are a cell-fate decision under oxidative and genotoxic stress: they dampen p53-driven apoptosis and stress kinase signalling and send cells into premature senescence and proliferative arrest. Here the stress is UV-induced damage.

theme: Embryonic heart development and cardiac morphogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways cover morphogenesis of the heart tube, ventricles, septa, outflow tract and great arteries from the second heart field and cardiac neural crest. Alongside them, the additional pathways specify the cardiac conduction system.

theme: Homeostasis of lymphoid progenitor numbers in thymus and marrow
core_role: The shared pathways are about balancing thymocyte proliferation, survival and differentiation. Here they serve cell-number homeostasis across primary lymphoid and haematopoietic tissues.

theme: RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signalling and its negative feedback
core_role: The shared pathways cover RAF/ERK activation (including MRAS-SHOC2 and oncogenic MAP2K mutants) together with phosphatase-mediated ERK inactivation and feedback. This is the tunable core of MAPK signalling, whose output includes AP-1 activation.

theme: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase fusions in cancer
core_role: The shared pathways are constitutively active FGFR1/2/3 fusion signalling. Here they are one case of oncogenic RTK fusions and mutants, alongside ALK, LTK and PDGFR drivers and their kinase inhibitors.

theme: ER-Golgi vesicle trafficking
core_role: The shared pathways cover vesicle targeting from the rough ER to the cis-Golgi. This is the forward (anterograde) leg of two-way ER-Golgi traffic, balanced by COPI retrograde transport.

theme: Endosome-Golgi retrograde trafficking and membrane recycling
core_role: The shared pathways cover retrograde transport from endosomes to the Golgi and retention of proteins in the Golgi. This is the sorting hub that returns receptors and machinery, linked to recycling to the plasma membrane and to delivery of lysosomal cargo.

theme: Neurotransmitter transport: vesicular loading and synaptic reuptake
core_role: The shared pathways cover SLC-mediated transport of neurotransmitters into synaptic vesicles and across the plasma membrane, including glycine transporter defects. Here they serve clearance and recycling of glycine, GABA and glutamate at synapses.

theme: Mitotic cell division from nuclear envelope to cytokinesis
core_role: The shared pathways cover nuclear envelope breakdown, ESCRT-III resealing and reassembly, and midbody abscission. These are the membrane-remodelling bookends of mitosis, framing the chromosome cohesion, condensation and spindle machinery in the additional pathways.

theme: Xenobiotic and drug metabolism and detoxification
core_role: The shared pathways cover phase I/II biotransformation of toxins, alcohols and steroids (CYP oxidation, sulfonation, aflatoxin activation). This is the general detoxification machinery that also governs drug ADME.

theme: Cytosolic nucleic acid sensing and type I interferon induction
core_role: The shared pathways cover IRF3-driven type I interferon induction downstream of cGAS-STING, together with its restraint. They sit alongside RIG-I/MDA5 RNA sensing and IFN-alpha antiviral effector responses.

theme: Pre-mRNA processing: splicing, 3'-end maturation and export
core_role: The shared pathways cover snRNP biogenesis, cap hypermethylation, snRNA transport and spliceosome function. This is the splicing stage of an mRNA maturation pipeline that continues with 3'-end processing and nuclear export.

theme: Sister chromatid cohesion during mitosis
core_role: The shared pathways cover release of cohesion and progression through mitosis. This is the resolution end of a cohesin cycle that runs through loading, establishment, maintenance and separation.

theme: Golgi-endosome membrane trafficking and recycling
core_role: The shared pathways cover cargo routing between the Golgi, endosomes and plasma membrane (constitutive secretion, endocytosis, receptor recycling). Here this routing is carried out through Golgi vesicle budding and membrane tubulation.

theme: Extracellular matrix collagen and elastic fibre assembly
core_role: The shared pathways cover collagen synthesis and fibril organisation and elastic fibre assembly. This is the structural ECM programme, completed by collagen crosslinking.

theme: Lymphocyte antigen-receptor signalling and co-stimulation/co-inhibition
core_role: The shared pathways cover proximal TCR signalling and its tuning by CD28 co-stimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition. This is the T-cell instance of setting antigen-receptor activation thresholds, paralleled by BCR signalling in B cells.

theme: AMPA receptor clustering and excitatory synaptic plasticity
core_role: The shared pathways cover postsynaptic diffusion-trapping, clustering and regulation of AMPA receptors, which set the strength of excitatory transmission. Here this is the substrate of synaptic plasticity and learning.

theme: p53 activation in DNA damage, apoptosis and cell-cycle control
core_role: The shared pathways cover activation of p53 by phosphorylation and its pro-apoptotic DNA-damage output. This tumour-suppressor node, when lost (TP53 mutation, p14ARF defects), lets cells evade senescence, apoptosis and cell-cycle checkpoints.

theme: Oxaloacetate-centred aspartate-glutamate metabolism and gluconeogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways cover the malate-aspartate shuttle and oxaloacetate metabolism. This is a transamination hub linking NADH transfer into mitochondria to amino acid metabolism and to carbon supply for gluconeogenesis.

theme: Glutamate-centred amino acid and nitrogen metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways cover interconversion of glutamate, glutamine, aspartate and alpha-ketoglutarate as the nitrogen-handling hub. Here this hub extends towards arginine/citrulline and aspartate-family amino acid metabolism.

theme: Postsynaptic structural plasticity
core_role: The shared pathways cover long-term plasticity and local translation at the synapse. Here these act to remodel the postsynapse through actin organisation, PSD maintenance and delivery of neurotransmitter receptors.

theme: Epithelial solute transport, tight junctions and osmotic stress
core_role: The shared pathways cover magnesium and inositol transport and the multimeric assembly of membrane proteins that mediate calcium-independent adhesion. Here these serve epithelial paracellular/tight-junction solute handling and osmolyte accumulation in hyperosmotic stress.

theme: Osteoblast differentiation and bone formation
core_role: The shared pathways cover Wnt-driven control of proliferation and differentiation in mesenchymal stem cells and osteoblasts. This is upstream signalling in skeletal development, acting with RUNX2 and BMP programmes towards ossification.

theme: Axon guidance by repulsive cues
core_role: The shared pathways cover Sema3A-plexin signalling (via PAK, CRMPs and integrin inhibition) that repels and steers growing axons. This sits within wider axon guidance and collateral-sprouting control, including netrin repulsion.

theme: Glutamate-glutamine nitrogen metabolism and ammonia homeostasis
core_role: The shared pathways cover glutamine/glutamate interconversion for fixing and using nitrogen and keeping ammonium in balance. The malate-aspartate shuttle links aspartate to mitochondrial redox.

theme: Dendritic cell lectin sensing driving cytokine production
core_role: The shared pathways are dendritic-cell cytokine output (IL-12, GM-CSF, induction of IFN-gamma), which primes type 1 responses. This output sits downstream of C-type lectin receptors (Dectin-1/2, DC-SIGN) recognising fungal and protozoan pathogens.

theme: Surface marker signatures of antigen-presenting cells
core_role: The shared pathways are surface receptor and transporter signatures of dendritic cells and monocytes, both resting and activated. They are read here as identity markers of antigen-presenting cell types, contrasted with B cell surface signatures.

theme: FGFR1/FGFR3 signalling and its regulation
core_role: The shared pathways cover ligand activation and FRS2/SHC adaptor-driven downstream cascades of FGFR1 and FGFR3, including activating mutants. Sprouty and FGFRL1 provide feedback tuning of this signalling.

theme: Cholinergic neurotransmission at the neuromuscular junction
core_role: The shared pathways cover presynaptic choline uptake (SLC5A7/CHT1, including its motor neuronopathy defects) and acetylcholine synthesis and release. This is the presynaptic side of cholinergic transmission onto nicotinic receptors.

theme: Reactive carbonyl detoxification and NAD+ redox metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways cover detoxification of methylglyoxal and aldehydes and repair of glycated proteins. This is carbonyl-stress defence, set beside NAD+ synthesis from tryptophan and salvage, which supplies redox cofactors.

theme: Axon guidance by attractive and repulsive cues
core_role: The shared pathways cover repulsive regulation of axon extension, chiefly Sema3A chemorepulsion. This is one guidance system among netrin/DCC, ephrin, Slit-Robo, DSCAM and L1-CAM cues that steer and bundle axons.

theme: Phagocyte antimicrobial killing and host-pathogen interaction
core_role: The shared pathways are phagocyte effector killing: NADPH-oxidase respiratory burst, neutrophil degranulation and cytotoxicity by neutrophils and macrophages. Here they form the host side of antibacterial and antifungal defence, alongside antimicrobial peptides, and are the target of subversion by pathogens such as Mtb and Listeria.
